data.name: Question2
data.value: How do I add a favorite League?

data.name: Question2Answer
data.value: Navigate to League Details from home page or Live page by tapping the appropriate header (the row showing the league name). On the League Details page, tap the "Star" icon at the top right corner. If you return back to home page, you will find the league you selected at the top of the page.

data.name: Question3
data.value: How do I add a favorite Match?

data.name: Question3Answer
data.value: In match list, tap the Star icon right next to the match or at the top right corner on Match Details page. As long as the Star is yellow, your match is added to Favorite Matches and you will receive notifications for that match.

data.name: Question4
data.value: Where do I find the standings for a specific league?

data.name: Question4Answer
data.value: Fixtures, Results and Standings (if applicable) for a league can be found by tapping on the league name. For example, to view the Standings of the English Premier League, tap the "Premier League" header (above the first Premier League match).

data.name: Question6
data.value: I subscribed the notifications for a specific match and the star next to the match is already orange, but I didn't receive any notification. What should I do?

data.name: Question6Answer
data.value: Make sure to enable the notifications for Score247 app on your phone System Settings, then re-open the app, unsubscribe the match and re-subscribe it. If this does not help, please contact our support team.

data.name: Question7
data.value: The line-ups are not match. Why was that?

data.name: Question7Answer
data.value: Line-ups change regularly over time and we try to update them continuously. The most reliable data is usually available 1 hour (or less) before the match starts. We also show the last time the update was made and whether they are confirmed or not. However, this information is available for some leagues only.

data.name: Question8
data.value: Why can't I find my favorite league in the list of matches?

data.name: Question8Answer
data.value: The favorite League is only visible during the day that has a match sheduled to be played. For example: England Premier League (EPL) is your favorite League and has some matches scheduled for Saturday 25 Jan and today is Monday 20 Jan, then that favorite league will be displayed on the SAT 25 Jan home page only - not on Today's home page.

data.name: Question9
data.value: I have noticed an error in your data. What should I do?

data.name: Question9Answer
data.value: If you want to report an error, please do not hesitate to contact us at http://www.score247.com/contact/. Thank you.

data.name: Question10
data.value: The start time of the match is not displayed correctly. Why was that?

data.name: Question10Answer
data.value: The start time of the match will be based on the time zone set on your device. Therefore, to get a proper start time, you will need to change the time zone on your device accordingly. Please note that you need to change the time zone instead of the displaying time.

data.name: Question11
data.value: Why are some leagues are not provided in your system?

data.name: Question11Answer
data.value: We are working to extend the list of supporting leagues. Feel free to request a new league on Facebook and we will consider it!

data.name: Question12
data.value: How do I turn off Breaking News alerts?

data.name: Question12Answer
data.value: Go to [Settings] > [Notifications] to toggle on/off the News alerts.

data.name: Question13
data.value: How do I turn off news notifications for a Favorite Match/League?

data.name: Question13Answer
data.value: Go to [Settings] > [Info Alert]. Here, you can manage all the notifications you want/ do not want to receive.

data.name: Question14
data.value: Why images aren’t loading?

data.name: Question14Answer
data.value:
• Check your network connection, make sure it is ON.
  • Clear the client cache: [Settings] > [Clear Cache].
  • Restart the device
  • If this problem still persists, please capture the screenshot of that page and send it to the [Feedback] along with the description, our staff will get to you as soon as possible.
